seo.title: Anassa Hotel Cyprus: Akamas Honeymoon Review (2026)
seo.description: Ultra-luxury on the wild Akamas peninsula. Score 94/100, from €750/night. Best room, 7-night plan, real cost, honest 2026 verdict, email.

content.verdict: Anassa is the single ultra-luxury property on the wild Akamas frontier — a low-rise village of whitewashed buildings spread across 17 hectares of pine-forested coast at Latchi, with a private golden-sand beach, a Byzantine-village-inspired layout, and a position that puts the protected Akamas Peninsula at the doorstep. Owned by Cyprus's Thanos Hotels and operating since 1998, Anassa has aged into the Mediterranean's quiet ultra-luxury anchor — the place that doesn't appear on Instagram bait lists because the clientele is the kind that doesn't post. The defining feature is the spa: a 2,500m² complex that consistently ranks in Europe's top five (Condé Nast Traveller, World Travel Awards, Forbes), with a thalassotherapy hammam and the only deep-rooted Anam Cara wellness programme on the island. The beach is genuinely the best on the west coast of Cyprus — a 600m crescent of soft yellow sand on Latchi Bay, calm sheltered water, with the Akamas headland rising behind. For a Cyprus honeymoon, Anassa is worth the splurge over every other property — five nights at Anassa plus three in Paphos or Limassol Old Town delivers the highest-quality version of the island.
content.best_room: Royal Suite with Private Pool — front-row position on the sea path with a 9m heated private pool, terrace overlooking Latchi Bay, indoor-outdoor stone bath, and direct walk-to-the-beach access. For honeymooners with higher budgets, the Anassa Royal Residence adds a private garden, fire pit, and the full butler-and-private-chef package. The Sea View Suite (no private pool) is the value entry point at around €750/night with the same Anassa service standard and walking distance to the beach.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival at Paphos International
itinerary_7_nights.description: Direct from London (4.5h) or Athens (1h) to Paphos (PFO), then a 50-minute private transfer northwest to Latchi. Anassa welcome at the entrance fountain, a chilled glass of commandaria. Sunset cocktails on the Pelagos terrace overlooking Latchi Bay; first dinner at Pelagos (signature seafood) with the Akamas headland glowing in the last light.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Beach and Spa Reset
itinerary_7_nights.description: Late breakfast at Helios (the main restaurant overlooking the beach), morning on the private beach with the Anassa butler service. Two-hour couples' thalassotherapy circuit at the spa — hammam, Vichy shower, deep-tissue massage. Evening sunset at the Beach Bar, dinner in-villa on the suite terrace.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Akamas Peninsula 4WD Safari
itinerary_7_nights.description: Anassa arranges the full-day Akamas jeep safari — Avakas Gorge hike, Blue Lagoon swim and lunch on board the boat, Lara Beach turtle station, and the Baths of Aphrodite freshwater pool. Return by 5pm for a swim and dinner at the Basiliko Greek taverna.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Aphrodite's Rock & Paphos Mosaics
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive south 90 minutes to Petra tou Romiou (Aphrodite's Rock) for the morning beach swim, then continue to Paphos for the UNESCO mosaics at the Archaeological Park and a fish lunch at Vasilikon in the old harbour. Return to Anassa by 6pm for sunset and an evening at the Pelagos.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Spa Day and Pool
itinerary_7_nights.description: Full rest day at Anassa — late breakfast, 90-minute couples massage in the spa, afternoon at the hammam, lounging by the main infinity pool. Dinner on the Royal Suite pool terrace (in-villa service is excellent).

itinerary_7_nights.title: Latchi Harbour and Sunset Sail
itinerary_7_nights.description: Half-day private gulet sail from Latchi harbour around the Akamas headland — snorkelling at the Blue Lagoon (smaller crowds in the late afternoon), swim-stops at hidden coves, sunset return to Latchi. Final dinner at Pelagos with the sommelier's commandaria pairing.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Final breakfast at Helios, last beach swim, 50-minute transfer back to PFO. Anassa late checkout is reliable for honeymooners — request 14:00 for the afternoon flights.

caveats: Anassa is family-friendly — there is a kids club and the main pool fills with families in July and August. Book a Royal Suite or Royal Residence for the secluded honeymoon experience; the entry Sea View rooms can hear pool noise mid-day in high season.

The Akamas Peninsula in front of the hotel is genuinely wild and unspoiled — there is no shopping, nightlife, or town within 20 minutes. Couples who want urban dimensions should split with Limassol Old Town.
The Anassa standard pricing is one of the highest on the island; in May or October the Royal Suite drops 25% but July–August book 6 months ahead for any availability.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Yes, ideal — Anassa is the definitive Cyprus honeymoon address, particularly in a Royal Suite category. The combination of the private beach, the top-five-in-Europe spa, and the Akamas Peninsula on the doorstep makes it the rare Mediterranean property that delivers ultra-luxury alongside genuine wild nature.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: May, June, September, and the first half of October are ideal — warm sea, warm land, no peak crowds. September is the best month overall: same heat as July, half the families. Avoid mid-July through mid-August for the heat and family-holiday peak.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: Royal Suites and the Royal Residence book 6 months ahead for July–September. May, June, and October have more flexibility. Mention honeymoon at booking — Anassa is consistent with honeymoon recognition (private dinner setup, champagne, spa credit).

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: No — Anassa is a family-friendly resort with a kids club and a family pool. Book the Royal Suite or Royal Residence categories for the most secluded experience; the Pelagos restaurant is 12+ for dinner and serves as the de facto adults-only evening venue.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Royal Suite with Private Pool — the front-row sea-path villas with a 9m heated private pool and direct beach access. The Royal Residence is the higher-budget upgrade with garden, fire pit, and a private chef option.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: Paphos International (PFO) is 50 minutes by private transfer (€90–€130 each way). Anassa arranges all transfers. Larnaca (LCA) is 2.5 hours and only worth it if PFO has no convenient connection from your home city.
